description: Gryphon playground — gryphon_playground's own PLUGIN-OWNED standalone-test profile, living inside the plugin (plugins/gryphon_playground/gryphon_playground.boot.json, named for the slug) so it travels with the plugin at repo extraction. Not a top-level boot/ profile; boot it with `spawn-session.sh --boot-file plugins/gryphon_playground/gryphon_playground.boot.json`. The closest-to-minimal standup TAP ships, existing only to exercise the Gryphon query language and nothing else. Installs just the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary and the gryphon_playground Gridkin corpus/harness that depends_on it. No admin chrome, no seeded data, no collectors: the grid comes up empty and reaches out to nothing, and the Gridkin corpus builds its scenarios at query/test time rather than seeding population (hence an empty population section). The web UI and API surfaces still mount (there is no landing/admin page without administrivia — auth/login is the only web chrome), because a truly headless boot — neither web UI nor API served — is not yet supported; it is tracked as backlog on each surface (tap_web req-web-rendering-headless; tap_api headless-API disable). Deliberately excludes everything the product/demo profiles carry so a Gryphon session stands up fast and clean.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the Gridkin corpus references by string. Its models are migrated (tables created) so the corpus has real types to query. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. Listed before gryphon_playground, which depends_on it.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.gryphon_playground). Install-only: the Gridkin scenario corpus + harness that exercise the Gryphon query language. Owns NO node/edge types of its own — its corpus references the grid_fixtures__* vocabulary by string, so it depends_on grid_fixtures (installed above). Carries NO GRIFT population seed. The whole point of this profile.
